name: itr-wala
title_zh: 帮你算清印度个税并生成 ITR 申报表
tagline_zh: 面对新旧税制、资本利得、加密货币不知怎么选？它能读懂 Form 16、AIS、TIS 和 26AS。
tagline_en: Old vs new regime, capital gains, crypto—it reads Form 16, AIS, TIS & 26AS, reconciles Zerodha/Groww/Upstox.
desc_en: File Indian income tax returns (ITR) for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. Use when the user wants to file their ITR, compute or verify Indian income tax, compare the old vs new tax regime, read a Form 16, AIS, TIS or Form 26AS, reconcile TDS, handle capital gains from Zerodha/Groww/Upstox statements, check their tax refund, or asks about ITR-1/ITR-2/ITR-3/ITR-4, sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, crypto tax,
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是按你的收入结构逐项匹配 ITR-1/2/3/4 与 80C/80D/87A/111A/。
why_en: Not a template—it maps your income structure to ITR-1/2/3/4 and sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, cross-checking TDS like a tax.
limit_zh: 只服务 FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27 印度居民；不处理非居民、合伙/公司税表；生成的是申报草稿。
limit_en: Only for Indian residents, FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. No non-resident, partnership, or corporate filings. Output is a draft—you must submit on the.
